text: The Big Dry. Hello, captain! I'm Mayor Puddle. Not one drop of rain has fallen on our three little planets for weeks. The ponds are dry and the frogs are grumpy!
Water, please! We need twelve crates of water. Buy them at any market you like, then share them out: four crates for each planet. Fair is fair!
Splash to it. I've marked the three thirsty planets in gold on your star map. Please hurry, captain. My tadpoles are counting on you!
Rain at last. Splish! Splash! The ponds are full, the gardens are green, and the frogs are singing again. Listen to that croaking choir!
A soggy thank you. Here's your reward, captain, and a lucky rain-drop to keep. Come back any time. Just bring an umbrella!
